Guest Author

TUCKER, Ga. — Poultry industry leaders from across Latin America and around the world will gather for the 2027 Latin American Poultry Summit, held in conjunction with the 2027 International Production & Processing Expo (IPPE) in Atlanta, Ga.

Under the theme, “Poultry Leads the Way in Animal Protein,” the Summit will explore the technologies, strategies and market opportunities shaping the future of poultry production.

The full-day program on Jan. 25 will bring together poultry executives, researchers and technical experts to address topics including genetics, bird health, precision nutrition, exports, robotics and automation. The Summit will open with research projects presented by the Latin American Poultry Association, followed by a broiler genetics roundtable featuring Alex Corzo, Cobb; Osvaldo Bolinaga, Aviagen; Jose Castilletti, Hubbard; and moderated by Carlos Chunga of MAP Global Media.

Additional presentations will examine bacteriophages and poultry production in the post-antibiotic era, advancements in intelligent lighting, the poultry industry’s position within the animal protein sector and the evolving role of precision nutrition. Strategies for transitioning from domestic poultry production to chicken and turkey exports, as well as early gut priming to support broiler performance, will also be discussed.

Speakers include Viviana Clavijo, Universidad de los Andes; Tomás Aragona, Signify; Pablo Sherwell, Rabobank North America; Mário Penz, Cargill; Juan Carlos Domínguez, ChileCarne; and José Ramírez, Anitox.

The educational program will conclude with a roundtable on “Robotics and Automation in the Poultry Industry: Which Path to Take?” featuring Cristóbal Jofre of MonitorOne and Gino Ponicke of Agrimesh and moderated by David Vargas of Wayne-Sanderson Farms.

Networking opportunities will be available throughout the day. This includes coffee breaks, lunch and a closing cocktail reception.

The 2027 Latin American Poultry Summit will be held Monday, Jan. 25, 2027, in Atlanta, one day before the 2027 IPPE, which will take place Jan. 26–28 at the Georgia World Congress Center.

Registration for IPPE and the Latin American Poultry Summit opened on Oct. 5. The registration rate for the Summit is $314 through Jan. 8, 2027. The rate is $449 starting Jan. 9. Registration includes interpretation, coffee breaks, lunch and a cocktail reception.

For more information about the 2027 Latin American Poultry Summit, visit www.lacumbreavicolalatinoamericana.org and, for the 2027 IPPE, visit www.ippexpo.org.

translationZh:
家禽行业领袖将齐聚一堂，参加与2027年国际生产与加工博览会（IPPE）同期举办的2027年拉丁美洲家禽峰会，地点位于佐治亚州亚特兰大。

本次峰会以“家禽引领动物蛋白发展”为主题，将探讨塑造家禽生产未来的技术、战略和市场机遇。

1月25日的全天议程将汇聚家禽企业高管、研究人员和技术专家，讨论遗传学、禽类健康、精准营养、出口、机器人及自动化等议题。峰会将由拉丁美洲家禽协会展示研究项目开场，随后举行肉鸡遗传学圆桌讨论，嘉宾包括Cobb公司的Alex Corzo、Aviagen公司的Osvaldo Bolinaga、Hubbard公司的Jose Castilletti，由MAP Global Media的Carlos Chunga主持。

其他演讲将探讨后抗生素时代的噬菌体与家禽生产、智能照明的进展、家禽行业在动物蛋白领域中的地位以及精准营养不断演变的作用。从国内家禽生产向鸡肉和火鸡肉出口转型的策略，以及早期肠道启动以支持肉鸡性能等议题也将被讨论。

演讲嘉宾包括安第斯大学的Viviana Clavijo、Signify公司的Tomás Aragona、Rabobank北美公司的Pablo Sherwell、Cargill公司的Mário Penz、ChileCarne的Juan Carlos Domínguez以及Anitox公司的José Ramírez。

教育议程将以“家禽行业的机器人与自动化：该走哪条路？”圆桌讨论收尾，嘉宾包括MonitorOne的Cristóbal Jofre和Agrimesh的Gino Ponicke，由Wayne-Sanderson Farms的David Vargas主持。

全天将提供社交机会，包括茶歇、午餐和闭幕鸡尾酒招待会。

2027年拉丁美洲家禽峰会将于2027年1月25日（周一）在亚特兰大举行，比2027年IPPE早一天。IPPE将于1月26日至28日在佐治亚世界会议中心举办。

IPPE和拉丁美洲家禽峰会的注册已于10月5日开放。峰会注册费在2027年1月8日前为314美元，1月9日起为449美元。注册费包含同声传译、茶歇、午餐和鸡尾酒招待会。

如需了解2027年拉丁美洲家禽峰会的更多信息，请访问www.lacumbreavicolalatinoamericana.org；如需了解2027年IPPE，请访问www.ippexpo.org。
